description: Gives Claude a living model of what your project is made of - what each part is for, what it depends on, and why - so answers about your software come from the software itself.
long_description:
s0ma gives Claude a living model of the software you are building: what each part is for, what it depends on, and why it is there. Answers about your project then come from the project itself, rather than from a guess made while reading its files.

This extension is a thin wrapper. It carries one small program that finds the copy of s0ma this computer should use, starts it, and fetches a newer one in the background - never in the middle of what you are doing. If s0ma is not installed yet the extension still starts, says so plainly, and names the one step that fixes it.

Your key from account.kn0wthyself.ai goes in this extension's settings. It is kept in this computer's secure storage, is never written into a settings file, and is never shown in a conversation. If you run s0ma from its source code you do not need a key at all.
name: s0ma

tools.description: Write down what an existing Python file is for, so old code can join the project's self-model a piece at a time.
tools.name: adopt_file

tools.description: Build the whole project from its self-model, once the checks are clean.
tools.name: build_project

tools.description: Check the project for problems and explain how to fix each one. Changes nothing.
tools.name: check

tools.description: List what s0ma can do in this project and which part fits the job in hand. Changes nothing.
tools.name: describe_server

tools.description: Set a project up to use s0ma, leaving everything already in it untouched.

tools.name: inspect_module

tools.name: learn_s0ma

tools.name: migrate_ext

tools.name: run_example
